snippet.title: Rogue Maze - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Tower defense is reinvented in this maze-defense roguelike! Design devious labyrinths fit to exhaust the unfortunate souls that enter by using special tiles that act as both your "towers" and pathway. Deploy gadgets, distractions, and tools to stay a step ahead!

Rogue Maze Demo coming May 28 for Windows, Mac, & Steam Deck. 

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3563500/?utm_campaign=demo_may2026 (Wishlists really help small indie devs, and you'll get notified when the Demo goes live!)

Keep up to date with our socials:
